diffs.diff: magnetic flux density (gauss): datasheet reading gives 625 per count, the part's model has 947
diffs.evidence: Same sensitivity at different supplies. AH49E datasheet Electrical Characteristics (@VCC = 5V): 'Output Voltage Sensitivity B = 0 to ±1000 (Gauss) 1.1 / 1.6 / 2.1 mV/Gauss' and 'VNULL Quiescent Output Voltage B = 0: 2.5 V'; description: 'The output voltage is set by the supply voltage and varies in proportion to the strength of the magnetic field'; Transferring Characteristics: 'the quiescent output voltage is one-half the supply voltage'. The second reading is the 5 V figure: 1/1.6 mV/G = 625 G/V, offset -2.5 V x 625 = -1562.5 G. The model runs the module from 3.3 V (required for ESP32/Pico ADC inputs; AH49E recommended VCC 3.0-6.5 V) and scales ratiometrically: 1.6 mV/G x 3.3/5 = 1.056 mV/G -> 947 G/V (625 x 5/3.3 = 947.0), null 1.65 V; sim vAtMin 0.594 V / vAtMax 2.706 V for -1000/+1000 G matches exactly. The driver takes vcc as a parameter and uses 625 G/V when vcc=5.0.
